newsitem.title: BURUNDI: Burundi rebels cut power to capital's suburbs.
newsitem.headline: Burundi rebels cut power to capital's suburbs.

text.p: Hutu rebels attacked an electricity pylon in north Burundi's Bubanza region on Tuesday cutting off power to the capital's northern suburbs, an army spokesman said.
"Rebels tried to destroy an electricity pylon in Bubanza and the technicians went there to repair it," said army spokesman Lieutenant-Colonel Isaie Nibizi.
Hutu rebels from the National Council for the Defence of Democracy (CNDD) attacked electricity lines interrupting power to Bujumbura for several weeks last year.
Rebels attacked and destroyed a coffee factory in Kiviuka commune, Bubanza, in a campaign to destroy economic infrastructure, a senior government official in Bubanza said.
More than 150,000 people -- mainly civilians -- have been killed since October 1993 in Burundi, where an ethnic civil war pits CNDD against the Tutsi-dominated army.
